title: Sore Throat & Tonsillitis (Pharyngitis / Galashundika) — Dual-System Monograph
source: NHS Guidelines & Ayurvedic Formulary of India
content:
Condition: Sore Throat, Pharyngitis & Tonsil Inflammation.
Allopathic Pharmacology: Paracetamol 500mg or Ibuprofen 400mg for pain/inflammation. Chlorhexidine or Povidone-Iodine 1% gargles. Benzydamine throat lozenges. (Antibiotics like Amoxicillin only if bacterial Strep confirmed by doctor).
Ayurvedic Formulations: Khadiradi Vati (chewable throat tablet 1-2 tablets), Yashtimadhu (Licorice / Mulethi powder 3g with honey), Triphala Kashaya gargling.
Home Remedies: Warm Salt Water Gargles (1/2 tsp salt in 1 glass warm water 3-4 times daily), Turmeric & Clove warm water gargles, Honey Ginger Lemon tea.
Red Flags: Inability to swallow saliva, difficulty breathing, or severe unilateral tonsil swelling.
